name: AiVisibility SEO-GEO Agent
author: AI-Visibility.io

sections.description:
Give every published page a clearer path to visibility across traditional search and AI-powered discovery.

AiVisibility SEO-GEO Agent audits published WordPress pages, posts, and WooCommerce products, then turns the analysis into practical, human-reviewable recommendations. See what is already working, identify important gaps, and review focused improvements for SEO titles, meta descriptions, Open Graph data, JSON-LD schema, headings, keyword targeting, and image alt text.

SEO supports visibility in traditional search engines. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) focuses on making content, entities, context, and structured information easier for AI-powered search and answer experiences to understand.

Why teams use AiVisibility

  • Get actionable, page-level SEO and GEO recommendations in one report.
  • Compare current page elements with clear recommended versions.
  • Review metadata, social sharing, structured data, headings, keywords, and images together.
  • Scan one URL when you need a focused audit or queue multiple URLs for broader coverage.
  • Keep reports inside WordPress for convenient review and follow-up.
  • Stay in control of every change.

How it works

  1. Activate the plugin and receive 5 complimentary service credits for a newly registered domain.
  2. Add your business context and SEO-GEO mode, then complete the SEO strategy manually or use the optional AI-powered fill.
  3. Scan a page, post, or WooCommerce product, or run a queue for multiple URLs.
  4. Review the AiVisibility report and choose which recommendations fit your website.
  5. Implement only the changes you approve. Additional service credits are optional.

Report-only by design

The plugin is report-only. It does not modify page content, metadata, headings, schema, image attributes, or other front-end output. Site administrators review the recommendations and decide which changes to make.

Compatibility

  • WordPress 6.0 or later; tested with WordPress 7.1.4.
  • PHP 7.4 or later, including PHP 8.5.

Open-source plugin and hosted AI service

The WordPress plugin is licensed under GPLv2 or later. Its source code is included in the download, together with the complete license in LICENSE.txt. You may use, study, modify, and redistribute the plugin under that license.

AiVisibility’s hosted AI processing is a separate service. Service credits and API access are governed by the service terms; those terms do not restrict the rights granted by the GPL for the WordPress plugin. The plugin license does not include unlimited or free access to the hosted AI service.

Start with 5 complimentary AI requests

The WordPress plugin and its report interface are available without a paid plugin license. AI processing is provided by the external AiVisibility service. A newly registered domain receives 5 complimentary service credits. Each successfully completed page, post, or product report uses one service credit. The optional AI-powered SEO Strategy fill also uses one service credit; completing and saving the strategy manually does not. Additional service credits can be purchased securely through Stripe Checkout only when needed.

Main features

  • Scan published pages, posts, and WooCommerce products.
  • Generate metadata and Open Graph/social recommendations.
  • Generate JSON-LD schema recommendations only when supported by page content.
  • Review heading, keyword, and image alt text recommendations.
  • Store per-page reports in WordPress.
  • Scan one URL or run a background queue for multiple URLs.
  • View remaining AiVisibility service credits in the WordPress admin screen.
  • Complete the SEO Strategy manually or use the optional AI-powered fill.
  • Start with 5 complimentary service credits and add more only when needed.

External service disclosure

AiVisibility SEO-GEO Agent connects to the AiVisibility service to generate the optional AI-powered SEO Strategy fill and SEO-GEO recommendation reports, verify the site, validate service credits, and create Stripe Checkout sessions for optional paid service credits.

The API endpoints are hosted on api1.aivisibility.gr, the API/server domain for the AiVisibility service at https://ai-visibility.io.

Depending on the requested action, the plugin sends page/post/product scan data; the site domain, home URL, site URL, WordPress language/locale, and administrator email address; the plugin version and generated site ID; and the selected AI profile, saved SEO strategy settings, and selected business profile fields to:

  • https://api1.aivisibility.gr/v1/seo/analyze
  • https://api1.aivisibility.gr/first_requests.php
  • https://api1.aivisibility.gr/stripe/create_checkout.php

For optional purchases, the plugin sends the site domain, site URL, generated site ID, requested credit quantity, and checkout return URLs to the checkout endpoint. Payment details are entered through Stripe Checkout and are not stored by this WordPress plugin.

The external service validates the site domain and generated site ID, checks or updates service credits, and returns strategy suggestions, recommendation reports, or Stripe Checkout links. AI provider credentials remain on the AiVisibility server and are not stored in this WordPress plugin.

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory, or upload the aivisibility-seo-geo-agent folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate AiVisibility SEO-GEO Agent from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the AiVisibility admin screen.
  4. Add your business details, choose an SEO-GEO mode, and save your SEO strategy.
  5. Use the 5 complimentary AI requests to fill the strategy or create your first page, post, or WooCommerce product reports.
  6. Review the recommendations and implement only the changes you choose.
  7. Add more service credits from the AiVisibility admin screen only when needed.
sections.faq:
Is the WordPress plugin open source?

Yes. AiVisibility SEO-GEO Agent is licensed under GPLv2 or later. The full plugin source and license are included in the download. Optional paid service credits cover external AI processing, independently of your GPL rights to the plugin.

What is GEO?

GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. It focuses on making content, entities, context, and structured information easier for AI-powered search and answer experiences to understand. AiVisibility combines GEO insights with established SEO signals in one report.

Does AiVisibility guarantee search rankings or AI citations?

No. No SEO or GEO tool can guarantee rankings, traffic, inclusion, or citations. AiVisibility provides structured recommendations that help administrators make informed optimization decisions.

Does the plugin include complimentary usage?

Yes. A newly registered domain receives 5 complimentary AiVisibility service credits. Each successfully completed page, post, or product report uses one service credit. The optional AI-powered SEO Strategy fill also uses one service credit, while completing the strategy manually does not.

What happens after the free credits are used?

Administrators can optionally buy additional service credits from the AiVisibility admin screen. Payments are processed through Stripe Checkout.

Does the plugin modify my website?

No. This WordPress.org edition is report-only. It scans content and displays recommendations without changing page content or front-end output.

What content can I audit?

You can audit published WordPress pages, posts, and WooCommerce products. Reports can cover metadata, Open Graph/social data, supported JSON-LD schema, headings, keyword targeting, and image alt text.

Can I scan one page or multiple pages?

Both. Run a focused scan for one URL or use the background queue to process multiple published URLs.

What data is sent to AiVisibility?

The plugin sends the selected page, post, or product scan data together with the site domain, site URL, plugin version, generated site ID, saved SEO strategy settings, and selected business profile fields. See the External service disclosure above for the exact endpoints and policies.

Does the plugin require an external service?

Yes. AI analysis, site verification, service-credit checks, and optional service-credit purchases use the AiVisibility service.

Does the plugin store an OpenAI API key?

No. AI provider credentials are handled server-side by AiVisibility.

  • Updated the plugin description and open-source licensing FAQ.

  • Standardized Open Graph labels in recommendation reports.
